HYUNDAI i20 BROCHURE
Ultimate Premium Hatchback Specs
Official Specifications and Features Guide
Document Version: 1.0 (July 2026)

Engine & Performance
The Hyundai i20 is powered by a 1.2-litre Kappa petrol engine generating 83 PS of maximum
power at 6000 rpm and 114.7 Nm of peak torque at 4200 rpm. It is mated to a 5-speed
manual transmission or an Intelligent Variable Transmission (IVT) option. There is also a
1.0-litre Turbo GDi petrol engine options generating 120 PS of maximum power at 6000 rpm
and 172 Nm of torque at 1500 - 4000 rpm mated to a 7-speed Dual Clutch Transmission
(DCT).

Mileage & Fuel Efficiency
The ARAI certified mileage for the Hyundai i20 petrol manual is 20.35 kmpl. The IVT
automatic transmission model offers a fuel economy of 19.65 kmpl. The high performance
1.0-litre Turbo GDi petrol engine DCT automatic variant delivers a fuel efficiency of 20.25
kmpl.

Safety Specifications
Safety is paramount in the Hyundai i20, which is equipped with 6 Airbags (Driver, Passenger,
Side & Curtain) as standard across all variants. It also features Electronic Stability Control
(ESC), Hill-start Assist Control (HAC), Vehicle Stability Management (VSM), and Anti-lock
Braking System (ABS) with Electronic Brake-force Distribution (EBD). Additionally, it comes
with ISOFIX child seat anchorages, rear parking sensors, and a Tyre Pressure Monitoring
System (TPMS).

Dimensions and Capacities
The Hyundai i20 has an overall length of 3995 mm, an overall width of 1775 mm, and an
overall height of 1505 mm. The wheelbase is 2580 mm. It has a fuel tank capacity of 37 litres.
The boot space capacity of the hatchback is 311 litres. Ground clearance is 170 mm under
standard conditions.

Interior & Comfort
The cabin of the Hyundai i20 features premium leatherette seat upholstery with copper
inserts. It is equipped with automatic climate control, cruise control, a smart electric sunroof,
rear AC vents, and a wireless charger with cooling pad. The steering wheel is a
leather-wrapped D-cut steering wheel with tilt and telescopic adjustments.

Infotainment & Connectivity
It features a 10.25-inch touchscreen infotainment system with Bose premium 7-speaker
sound system including a sub-woofer. It supports wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
connectivity, Bluetooth multi-connection, USB charger, and Bluelink connected car technology
with over 60 connected features.
